messages.subject: Kaiser, acceleration factor, and optimal coordinates
parts:
Hi all,

Recently, I read Multivariate Genomic Architecture of Cortical Thickness and Surface Area at Multiple Levels of Analysis (https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2022.02.19.22271223v2) paper in MedRxiv and in the methods, it mentions additional tests were performed, such as Kaiser, acceleration factor, optimal coordinates, to determine appropriate number of factors to use in EFA.

I also wanted to try out these tests, but it seems to require raw data in addition to correlation matrix. So, I'm planning to use betas of traits from the result obtained by the sumstat function. Is this a correct approach, or would there be other ways to perform those tests?

Thanks a lot!

Austin
